description: Note Currently, this policy is supported only in HoloLens 2, Hololens (1st gen) Commercial Suite, and HoloLens (1st gen) Development Edition. Enables USB connection between the device and a computer to sync files with the device or to use developer tools to deploy or debug applications. Changing this policy does not affect USB charging. Both Media Transfer Protocol (MTP) and IP over USB are disabled when this policy is enforced. Most restricted value is 0.
